title: Colorado methods, restrictions, and GMU rules

methods.label: Archery
methods.summary: Longbow, recurve, or compound bow meeting CPW draw-weight and broadhead rules for big game.

methods.label: Muzzleloader
methods.summary: Muzzleloader-only season uses legal muzzleloading rifles; optics rules follow the brochure.

methods.label: Rifle / firearm
methods.summary: Centerfire rifles and other legal firearms for regular rifle seasons.

methods.label: Any legal method
methods.summary: Some plains elk seasons allow any legal method of take for the license.

methods.label: Shotgun
methods.summary: Shotguns for turkey, dove, and small game as listed.

prohibited: Hunting without a valid license for that species, unit, and manner of take.
Hunting in closed areas, national parks, or private land without permission.
Using artificial light or thermal/night vision where prohibited.
Shooting from or across a public road.
unitRules: Limited licenses are valid only in the GMU(s) printed on the license.
OTC elk licenses list eligible units; you choose among them for that season.
Plains (east of I-25) deer and elk seasons differ from west-of-I-25 structure.
Manner of take (archery, muzzleloader, rifle) is part of the hunt code.
